description: Get one order's full details by its id: items, the full money column (subtotal, discount, shipping, tax, total - all minor units), displayMode (net or gross, how the buyer read prices), taxRoundingMethod (per_line or per_rate), taxTreatment (kind standard, reverse_charge, exempt or export - goods shipped out of the EU VAT area, or from a seller outside the EU to another country, frozen at checkout with the facts it rests on: legalNote, the text to print on the invoice, null for standard; buyerVatId, buyerVatCountry and buyerVatVerifiedAt of the VAT id that decided it; sellerCountry; shipToCountry; orders placed before it was recorded read standard), removedTax (VAT taken out of gross-stored prices on a reverse_charge, exempt or export order, minor units, 0 otherwise; total = subtotal - discount + shippingTotal - removedTax), amounts (net, tax and gross of subtotal, discount, shipping and total), the frozen discount code, channel (the sales channel the order was placed through: id, key, name; null for none), priceList / priceListName (the primary price list the order was priced from, name frozen at checkout; null when none) and priceListSource (MEMBER, COMPANY or CHANNEL - whose list it was), pricingChain (the lists tried in order: buyer, channelDated, channelBase; each null when none) - every list reference carries deleted, true once that list was deleted after the order, and each item's priceListId / priceListSource name the list that priced that line, PO number, shipping address, payment/fulfillment status, amountPaid (collected so far), balanceDue (total - amountPaid, what the buyer still owes; a refund does not change it), refundedAmount (refunded so far across every refund, minor units; left to refund = amountPaid - refundedAmount), refundedAt (when the latest refund was recorded, null when none), refundReferences (the refund references recorded, oldest first - refund_order and refund_return ignore a reference already listed), invoices (every invoice recorded, oldest first: kind invoice - at most one, the order's invoice - then its corrections of kind correction, each with number, url, provider and issuedAt; record_order_invoice adds the invoice, record_order_invoice_correction a correction), and the parcels (shipments: id, carrier, tracking number and link, status, history) - a parcel's id is what update_shipment takes - the returns (id, number, status, lines with reason and received/restocked units, return-parcel tracking, refunded amount, history) - a return's id is what the *_return tools take - and customFields, the order's custom field values by key.
name: get_order
title: Get order
